title: Kenyan Stew
description: A hearty stew with a Kenyan twist, inspired by French cuisine. This dish is perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: Kenyan spices
ingredients.notes: Use a combination of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until they're translucent.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Kenyan spices, cashew nuts, and tomato paste. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
